Heading: Game Introduction
Text (JP): いいバトルだったな。
Text (EN): That was a good battle.

Heading: Game Introduction
Text (JP): 久しぶりにゾクゾクしたよ……。
Text (EN): It's been a while since I felt a thrill like that...

Heading: Game Introduction
Text (JP): お前の考えてること、当ててやろうか？
Text (EN): Shall I guess what you're thinking?

Heading: Game Introduction
Text (JP): 首都高でトップに立ちたい──。違うか？
Text (EN): You want to reach the top of the Shuto Expressway──. Am I wrong?

Heading: Game Introduction
Text (JP): この場所を走っている連中の考えていることなんて、
Text (EN): What the guys running this place are thinking,

Heading: Game Introduction
Text (JP): だいたい似たり寄ったりだ。
Text (EN): it's pretty much all the same.

Heading: Game Introduction
Text (JP): だが、実際にそれを成し遂げられる者はほとんどいない。
Text (EN): But in reality, almost no one actually achieves it.

Heading: Game Introduction
Text (JP): もし本気なら、まずはＣ１を制覇することだな。
Text (EN): If you're serious, first you need to conquer C1.

Heading: Game Introduction
Text (JP): ブラッドハウンド、１２時過ぎのシンデレラ、
Text (EN): 【BLOODHOUND】, 【CINDERELLA PAST MIDNIGHT】,

Heading: Game Introduction
Text (JP): そして白銀の貴公子──。
Text (EN): and 【SILVERY NOBLEMAN】──.

Heading: Game Introduction
Text (JP): この３台が現在、Ｃ１最速と言われている連中だ。
Text (EN): These three machines are currently said to be the fastest on C1.

Heading: Game Introduction
Text (JP): ヤツらを撃墜できれば、事実上、Ｃ１を制したってことになる。
Text (EN): If you can defeat them, you've virtually conquered C1.

Heading: Game Introduction
Text (JP): お前にホンモノの実力があれば、出会えるかもナ。
Text (EN): If you have real skill, you might meet them.

Heading: Game Introduction
Text (JP): 出会えなかったら？
Text (EN): And if you don't?

Heading: Game Introduction
Text (JP): しょせんその程度の走り屋だったというだけのことさ。
Text (EN): Then you were just a street racer of that level, that's all.

Heading: Night Introduction
Text (JP): ん？　なんか用かい？
Text (EN): Hm? You need something?

Heading: Night Introduction
Text (JP): おぅ、確かに俺はブラッドハウンドと呼ばれているよ。
Text (EN): Yeah, I'm indeed called 【BLOODHOUND】.

Heading: Night Introduction
Text (JP): いちおう、この時間帯のＣ１では最速ってコトになっているらしいね。
Text (EN): Supposedly, I'm known as the fastest on C1 at this time of night.

Heading: Night Introduction
Text (JP): なんだって？　俺とバトルしたい？
Text (EN): What's that? You want to battle me?

Heading: Night Introduction
Text (JP): おいおい、人をからかうのもいい加減にしろよ。
Text (EN): Hey now, quit pulling my leg.

Heading: Night Introduction
Text (JP): だって、そうだろ？
Text (EN): I mean, look at it.

Heading: Night Introduction
Text (JP): お前さんのマシンからは何のオーラも感じられねぇ。
Text (EN): I don't feel any aura coming from your machine.

Heading: Night Introduction
Text (JP): こう見えても、俺は結構、忙しくてね。
Text (EN): Believe it or not, I'm pretty busy.

Heading: Night Introduction
Text (JP): シロート相手にクルマの運転を教えているヒマはないんだ。
Text (EN): I don't have time to teach amateur drivers how to drive a car.

Heading: Night Introduction
Text (JP): もし、本気だっていうんなら、自分の実力を示してみな。
Text (EN): If you're serious, prove your skills.

Heading: Night Introduction
Text (JP): 方法は……わかるだろ？
Text (EN): The method... you know what it is, right?

Heading: Blood Hound Clear
Text (JP): お前さんの実力、しっかり見せてもらったよ。
Text (EN): You've shown me your skills loud and clear.

Heading: Blood Hound Clear
Text (JP): 正直、見違えたぜ。あの時のどん臭ぇ走り屋と同じ人間とは思えねぇ。
Text (EN): Honestly, you're a completely different driver. I can't believe you're the same clumsy racer from before.

Heading: Blood Hound Clear
Text (JP): 俺の見る目もあんまりアテになんねぇって、な。
Text (EN): Turns out my eye for talent isn't very reliable, either.

Heading: Blood Hound Clear
Text (JP): お前と走っていて、あいつを思い出した。
Text (EN): Racing with you made me remember that guy.

Heading: Blood Hound Clear
Text (JP): 伝説の走り屋、迅帝──。
Text (EN): The legendary street racer, 【SWIFT EMPEROR】──.

Heading: Blood Hound Clear
Text (JP): かつて首都高最速と呼ばれていた男さ。
Text (EN): He was the man once called the fastest on the Shuto Expressway.

Heading: Blood Hound Clear
Text (JP): 今はどうしているんだろうな。
Text (EN): I wonder what he's doing now.

Heading: Blood Hound Clear
Text (JP): あいつがこの場所を去ってからもう３年経つ。
Text (EN): It's been three years since he left this place.

Heading: Blood Hound Clear
Text (JP): 首都高もすっかり変わっちまったよ。
Text (EN): The Shuto Expressway has completely changed.

Heading: Blood Hound Clear
Text (JP): あいつならお前の潜在能力を引き出してくれたかもしれないな。
Text (EN): If it were him, he might have been able to draw out your full potential.

Heading: Blood Hound Clear
Text (JP): まぁ、悔やんでてもしかたねぇ。
Text (EN): Well, no point in dwelling on the past.

Heading: Blood Hound Clear
Text (JP): お前さんはお前さんのやり方で頂点を目指してみろ。
Text (EN): You should aim for the top in your own way.

Heading: Shibuya Unlock (Blood Hound)
Text (JP): そういやぁ、３号渋谷線にはもう行ってみたか？
Text (EN): By the way, have you checked out Route 3 Shibuya Line yet?

Heading: Shibuya Unlock (Blood Hound)
Text (JP): 今のお前さんにできるのは場数を踏むことだ。
Text (EN): What you need to do right now is gain more experience.

Heading: Shibuya Unlock (Blood Hound)
Text (JP): いっぺん顔出してみるのも悪くないぜ。
Text (EN): It wouldn't be a bad idea to pay a visit once.

Heading: Daybreak Introduction
Text (JP): 僕に何か用かい？
Text (EN): Do you need something from me?

Heading: Daybreak Introduction
Text (JP): 朝イチで会議が入っているので、手短に頼むよ。
Text (EN): I have a meeting first thing in the morning, so make it quick.

Heading: Daybreak Introduction
Text (JP): まさかバトルの申し込み……とかいうんじゃないだろうな？
Text (EN): Don't tell me you're challenging me to a battle...?

Heading: Daybreak Introduction
Text (JP): 白銀の貴公子を知らないのか？
Text (EN): Don't you know who 【SILVERY NOBLEMAN】 is?

Heading: Daybreak Introduction
Text (JP): 夜明けのＣ１では敵なしと言われている走り屋だ。
Text (EN): I am the street racer said to have no equal on C1 at daybreak.

Heading: Daybreak Introduction
Text (JP): 君は今、その男にバトルを挑もうとしているんだぞ。
Text (EN): You are trying to challenge that very man to a battle right now.

Heading: Daybreak Introduction
Text (JP): 悪いが、時間の無駄だよ。
Text (EN): Sorry, but it's a waste of time.

Heading: Daybreak Introduction
Text (JP): 僕についてこれるだけの実力があるとは思えない。
Text (EN): I don't think you have the skill to keep up with me.

Heading: Daybreak Introduction
Text (JP): 僕は撃墜する価値のあるヤツとしか走らないんだ。
Text (EN): I only race against opponents who are worth defeating.

Heading: Daybreak Introduction
Text (JP): 今の君を破ったところで何の得にもならない。
Text (EN): Defeating you as you are now gains me nothing.

Heading: Daybreak Introduction
Text (JP): 経験を積んでから出直すことだな。
Text (EN): Gain some experience and come back later.

Heading: Silvery Nobleman Clear
Text (JP): 君の走り、僕の想像を遥かに超えていたよ。
Text (EN): Your driving far exceeded my expectations.

Heading: Silvery Nobleman Clear
Text (JP): この前は君のことを侮るような発言をしてすまなかった。
Text (EN): I apologize for my disrespectful remarks the other day.

Heading: Silvery Nobleman Clear
Text (JP): 首都高最速の走り屋──迅帝が去った今、自分の実力も省みず、
Text (EN): Now that the fastest racer on the Shuto Expressway, 【SWIFT EMPEROR】, is gone,

Heading: Silvery Nobleman Clear
Text (JP): 夢ばかり見ているような連中が多くて、うんざりしていたんだ。
Text (EN): I was sick and tired of all the guys dreaming big without reflecting on their own lack of skill.

Heading: Silvery Nobleman Clear
Text (JP): だが、君はそうじゃない。
Text (EN): But you are different.

Heading: Silvery Nobleman Clear
Text (JP): ひょっとしたら、君こそ、新たな迅帝とも言える存在になりうる
Text (EN): It occurred to me that perhaps you could become a presence

Heading: Silvery Nobleman Clear
Text (JP): のではないか、とそんな気がしてきた。
Text (EN): that could be called the new 【SWIFT EMPEROR】.

Heading: Silvery Nobleman Clear
Text (JP): そう言われても君には迷惑な話だろう。
Text (EN): Hearing that might just be a burden to you, though.

Heading: Silvery Nobleman Clear
Text (JP): 君は君の走りを極めればいい。
Text (EN): You should simply master your own style of driving.

Heading: Silvery Nobleman Clear
Text (JP): 僕にできることがあったら、何でも言ってくれ。
Text (EN): If there's anything I can do, just let me know.

Heading: Silvery Nobleman Clear
Text (JP): この場所は長いんだ。それなりに知り合いも多い。
Text (EN): I've been in this place for a long time. I know quite a few people.

Heading: Silvery Nobleman Clear
Text (JP): 君に出会えてよかったよ。
Text (EN): I'm glad I met you.

Heading: Silvery Nobleman Clear
Text (JP): ……ひょっとしたら、弟が君に引き合わせてくれたのかもしれないな。
Text (EN): ...Perhaps my younger brother brought us together.

Heading: Shibuya Unlock (Silvery Nobleman)
Text (JP): 最後に１つだけ、君に教えておこう。
Text (EN): Let me tell you just one last thing.

Heading: Shibuya Unlock (Silvery Nobleman)
Text (JP): ３号渋谷線。あそこにも最速の走り屋を目指す連中がいる。
Text (EN): Route 3 Shibuya Line. There are guys over there aiming to be the fastest, too.

Heading: Shibuya Unlock (Silvery Nobleman)
Text (JP): 君の腕を試すいい機会だ。行ってみてはどうだ？
Text (EN): It's a good opportunity to test your skills. Why don't you go check it out?

Heading: Midnight Introduction
Text (JP): ふーん、アンタも走り屋なんだ？
Text (EN): Hmm, so you're a street racer too?

Heading: Midnight Introduction
Text (JP): えっ、私とバトルしたいって？
Text (EN): What, you want to battle me?

Heading: Midnight Introduction
Text (JP): ちょっ……ゴメン。マジ、ウケちゃった。
Text (EN): Wait... sorry. That actually cracked me up.

Heading: Midnight Introduction
Text (JP): あのネ、念のために言っておくけど、
Text (EN): Look, just to be clear,

Heading: Midnight Introduction
Text (JP): 私、ここでは１２時過ぎのシンデレラって呼ばれてて、
Text (EN): around here I'm called 【CINDERELLA PAST MIDNIGHT】,

Heading: Midnight Introduction
Text (JP): この時間帯のＣ１では一番速いって言われてンの。
Text (EN): and they say I'm the fastest on C1 at this time of night.

Heading: Midnight Introduction
Text (JP): 別に馬鹿にしてるワケじゃないんだけど、
Text (EN): It's not that I'm making fun of you,

Heading: Midnight Introduction
Text (JP): 今のアンタと走っていても、何かを得られる気がしないんだよね。
Text (EN): but racing against you as you are now, I don't feel like I'd gain anything.

Heading: Midnight Introduction
Text (JP): バトルって一種のコミュニケーションでしょ？
Text (EN): A battle is a form of communication, right?

Heading: Midnight Introduction
Text (JP): 少なくとも今の私たちは同じ「言葉」で語り合うことはできない。
Text (EN): At the very least, right now we can't speak the same "language."

Heading: Midnight Introduction
Text (JP): 「その時」が来れば自然と出会える──。
Text (EN): When "that time" comes, we'll meet naturally──.

Heading: Midnight Introduction
Text (JP): そういうものだと思わない？
Text (EN): Don't you think that's how it works?

Heading: After Midnight Cinderella Clear
Text (JP): 驚いたよ。アンタがあんなに速いなんて……。
Text (EN): I was amazed. I had no idea you were that fast...

Heading: After Midnight Cinderella Clear
Text (JP): 走り屋は見かけじゃないってことがよーくわかった。
Text (EN): I learned loud and clear that you can't judge a street racer by appearances.

Heading: After Midnight Cinderella Clear
Text (JP): アンタ、私が昔、憧れていた走り屋に似ている……。
Text (EN): You remind me of a street racer I used to admire...

Heading: After Midnight Cinderella Clear
Text (JP): 迅帝──。名前くらい聞いたことがあるでしょ？
Text (EN): 【SWIFT EMPEROR】──. You've at least heard the name, right?

Heading: After Midnight Cinderella Clear
Text (JP): 首都高最速の走り屋。
Text (EN): The fastest street racer on the Shuto Expressway.

Heading: After Midnight Cinderella Clear
Text (JP): ある夜、突然、首都高に現われ、あっという間に頂点に立った男。
Text (EN): A man who suddenly appeared on the Shuto Expressway one night and reached the top in the blink of an eye.

Heading: After Midnight Cinderella Clear
Text (JP): 一度だけ、彼を見たことがあるの。早朝のＣ１、芝公園付近だったわ。
Text (EN): I saw him just once, early in the morning on C1 near Shiba Park.

Heading: After Midnight Cinderella Clear
Text (JP): 後ろから信じられないようなスピードで追い上げてきて、気が付くと
Text (EN): He came up from behind at unbelievable speed, and before I knew it,

Heading: After Midnight Cinderella Clear
Text (JP): アッという間に私を抜いて走り去って行った……。
Text (EN): he passed me in a flash and drove off...

Heading: After Midnight Cinderella Clear
Text (JP): その後、姿を消してしまったけど、今でも私の中で彼はヒーローよ。
Text (EN): After that, he disappeared, but in my mind, he's still a hero.

Heading: After Midnight Cinderella Clear
Text (JP): アンタもいつか彼みたいなスペシャルな走り屋になってよね。
Text (EN): You need to become a special street racer like him someday, okay?

Heading: After Midnight Cinderella Clear
Text (JP): 期待してるからね！
Text (EN): I'm counting on you!

Heading: Shibuya Unlock (After Midnight Cinderella)
Text (JP): そうそう、３号渋谷線にはもう行ってみた？
Text (EN): Oh right, have you checked out Route 3 Shibuya Line yet?

Heading: Shibuya Unlock (After Midnight Cinderella)
Text (JP): あそこにも実力のある走り屋がいるって話だよ。
Text (EN): Word is there are capable street racers over there too.

Heading: Shibuya Unlock (After Midnight Cinderella)
Text (JP): 腕試しにはもってこいじゃない？
Text (EN): Wouldn't it be perfect for testing your skill?

Heading: Stage 2 Introduction
Text (JP): お前がＣ１のトップ３を撃墜したって話、本当か？
Text (EN): Is it true that you defeated the C1 Top 3?

Heading: Stage 2 Introduction
Text (JP): だが、安心するのはまだ早いんじゃねーの？
Text (EN): But isn't it too early to relax?

Heading: Stage 2 Introduction
Text (JP): Ｃ１だけが首都高じゃないってことさ。
Text (EN): C1 isn't the only part of the Shuto Expressway.

Heading: Stage 2 Introduction
Text (JP): 浜崎橋から江戸橋までのＣ１と江戸橋から辰巳までの９号深川線、
Text (EN): The course made of C1 from Hamazakibashi to Edobashi, Route 9 Fukagawa Line from Edobashi to Tatsumi,

Heading: Stage 2 Introduction
Text (JP): それから湾岸線、１１号台場線で構成されているコース──
Text (EN): plus the Bayshore Line and Route 11 Daiba Line──

Heading: Stage 2 Introduction
Text (JP): 俺たちは「新環状」って呼んでいるが、そこを走っている連中は
Text (EN): we call it the "New Belt Line," and the guys running over there

Heading: Stage 2 Introduction
Text (JP): Ｃ１なんかとは比べものにならないくらい速いって話だ。
Text (EN): are said to be incomparably faster than anyone on C1.

Heading: Stage 2 Introduction
Text (JP): 最近、アメリカからやってきたというスカールバレットと
Text (EN): Lately, word has it that 【SKULL BULLET】, who came over from America,

Heading: Stage 2 Introduction
Text (JP): そいつに協力している３人の走り屋たち、紺碧のスナイパー、
Text (EN): along with three street racers cooperating with him──【DEEP BLUE SNIPER】,

Heading: Stage 2 Introduction
Text (JP): 沈黙のカシオペア、夜明けのガーネット──。
Text (EN): 【SILENT CASSIOPEIA】, and 【GARNET OF DAWN】──

Heading: Stage 2 Introduction
Text (JP): お前が新環状で有名になりゃ、いずれぶつかるんじゃねーの？
Text (EN): If you make a name for yourself on the New Belt Line, you're bound to clash with them eventually.

Heading: Stage 2 Introduction
Text (JP): ま、せいぜいがんばりな。
Text (EN): Well, do your best.

Heading: First Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): スカールバレットの仲間の１人を撃墜したそうだな。
Text (EN): I heard you defeated one of 【SKULL BULLET】's allies.

Heading: First Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): 相変わらず、驚かせてくれるじゃないか。
Text (EN): As usual, you never fail to surprise me.

Heading: First Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): 今日、ヘンな噂を耳にした。
Text (EN): I heard a strange rumor today.

Heading: First Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): いちおう、君にも教えておこうと思ってね。
Text (EN): I thought I should let you know, just in case.

Heading: First Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): ４号新宿線で伝説の走り屋、迅帝を見た奴がいるらしいんだ。
Text (EN): Supposedly someone saw the legendary street racer, 【SWIFT EMPEROR】, on Route 4 Shinjuku Line.

Heading: First Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): もう３年も首都高に姿を見せちゃいないから、何かの間違いだとは思う
Text (EN): He hasn't shown his face on the Shuto Expressway for three years now, so I assume it's a mistake,

Heading: First Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): が、もし本当なら会いに行くべきだろう。
Text (EN): but if it's true, you ought to go see him.

Heading: First Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): 僕自身、まだ会ったことはないが、彼の走りを見ることによって、
Text (EN): I haven't met him myself, but I feel like seeing his driving

Heading: First Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): 確実に君自身の走りも変わっていく……そんな気がするんだ。
Text (EN): will surely change your own driving as well.

Heading: First Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): 噂では４号線のＰＡに青いスカイラインクーペに乗ってきたらしい。
Text (EN): Rumor says he arrived at the Route 4 parking area in a blue Skyline Coupe.

Heading: First Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): 僕は伝えるべき情報を伝えた。後は君しだいだ。
Text (EN): I've passed along the info. The rest is up to you.

Heading: Second Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): また、スカールバレットの仲間を撃墜したのね。
Text (EN): You defeated another one of 【SKULL BULLET】's allies, didn't you?

Heading: Second Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): アンタ、どんどん速くなっている……。
Text (EN): You're getting faster and faster...

Heading: Second Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): 覚えてる？　アンタが迅帝に似ているっていう話。
Text (EN): Do you remember when I said you resembled 【SWIFT EMPEROR】?

Heading: Second Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): 最近、アンタが誰々を撃墜したとか、どこどこのチームを破ったという
Text (EN): Lately, whenever I hear rumors about you defeating someone

Heading: Second Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): 噂を聞くたびに胸の奥が痛むの。アンタも迅帝のようにどこかに
Text (EN): or beating some team, my chest aches.

Heading: Second Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): 消えてしまうんじゃないかって……。
Text (EN): I worry that you'll disappear somewhere just like 【SWIFT EMPEROR】...

Heading: Second Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): ゴメン、なんかつまんない話しちゃって。
Text (EN): Sorry, that was a dull thing to talk about.

Heading: Second Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): 私にはずっと走ることしかなかったから……。
Text (EN): Racing was all I ever had for a long time...

Heading: Second Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): なぁんか、どんな話をすればいいのかよくわかんないんだよね。
Text (EN): Somehow, I don't really know what kind of things I should talk about.

Heading: Second Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): また、来るよ。おやすみ。
Text (EN): I'll come by again. Good night.

Heading: Third Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): ついにスカールバレットの仲間を全員撃破しちまいやがったか。
Text (EN): So you finally took down all of 【SKULL BULLET】's allies.

Heading: Third Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): お前さん、なかなかやるじゃないか。
Text (EN): You're pretty impressive, kid.

Heading: Third Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): これでスカールバレットも黙っちゃいないだろう。
Text (EN): Now 【SKULL BULLET】 won't be sitting quietly, either.

Heading: Third Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): いよいよ来るべき時が来たって感じだな。
Text (EN): It feels like the time has finally come.

Heading: Third Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): あの男、あっちの非合法レース界では相当速かったらしいよ。
Text (EN): That guy was supposedly extremely fast in the illegal racing scene over there.

Heading: Third Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): 油断していると、足元をすくわれるぜ。
Text (EN): If you drop your guard, he'll sweep the rug right out from under you.

Heading: Third Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): そう言やぁ、迅帝のヤツ、こっそり戻ってきているんだって？
Text (EN): Speaking of which, I hear 【SWIFT EMPEROR】 secretly came back?

Heading: Third Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): まったく、俺にあいさつもなく、あいかわらず冷たいよなぁ。
Text (EN): Man, not even a greeting to me—cold as ever, as usual.

Heading: Third Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): あいつとは古い付き合いでね。
Text (EN): I've known him for a long time.

Heading: Third Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): 俺がまだ十三鬼将と呼ばれていた頃からの腐れ縁だ。
Text (EN): An unbreakable bond from back when I was still called one of the "THIRTEEN DEVILS."

Heading: Third Skull Bullet Friend Clear
Text (JP): だから、俺はあいつの性格を知り尽くしている。
Text (EN): That's why I know his personality inside and out.

Heading: Third Skull Bullet Friend Clear
